Name: World Map Gamepad Autonav
Author: amoremsg
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b]World Map Gamepad Autonav[/b][/size]
[size=4][color=#f39c12]Seamless gamepad navigation, automatic route generation, and on-the-fly free cursor toggle for all modded maps![/color][/size]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]🌟 What is this mod?[/b][/size]
Playing Stardew Valley with a controller is fantastic—until you install expansion mods like [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b], [b]Ridgeside Village[/b], or [b]Sunberry Village[/b]. Modded world maps often lack gamepad snapping routes, making it impossible to navigate to modded buildings, leaving you stuck or forced to reach for a mouse.

[b]World Map Gamepad Autonav solves this once and for all. It automatically scans all world map data at runtime, cleans phantom triggers, and mathematically builds snappy 4-way gamepad navigation routes across [b]every map region[/b]. Plus, it introduces an on-demand [b]Free Map Cursor[/b] mode at the click of a stick!
[/b]
[line]
[b]
[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b][b]Automatic Route Generation:[/b] Dynamically connects all points of interest across all regions (Pelican Town, Ginger Island, Ridgeside Village, Sunberry Village, Crimson Badlands, Highlands, Grampleton, etc.). No manual patches or JSON editing required![/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Zero Dead Ends & Smart Proximity:[/b] Solves tricky overlapping landmarks (such as the Bus Stop and Cable Car) with dedicated mutual links so you never get trapped.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Phantom Trigger Cleanup:[/b] Automatically ignores 1x1 audio triggers, placeholder anchors, and invisible tooltips—your cursor only snaps to real, visible landmarks.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Full Ridgeside Village Map Support:[/b] Adds a snappable button for Ridgeside Village on the Pelican Town map. Fixes the original RSV bug that disabled the button when standing in modded areas like Road to Sunberry.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Free Map Cursor Toggle (R3 / L3):[/b] Click your right stick ([b]R3[/b]) or left stick ([b]L3[/b]) at any time on the map to switch between snappy point-to-point snapping and smooth virtual mouse movement![/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Smart Cursor Snap & Centering:[/b]
 [/b]
[list]
 [*][b] In Free Cursor mode, the pointer automatically centers on the map upon opening.
  [/b][/*]
[*][b]Switching back to Point-to-Point mode automatically locks onto the landmark closest to where you left your free cursor.
  [/b][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b][b]Session Mode Memory:[/b] The mod remembers your preferred cursor mode across map views, region transitions, and menu tabs until you toggle it again.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) Integration:[/b] Customize your toggle button (R3 or L3) directly in-game.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Fully Localized (i18n):[/b] Supports 9 languages out-of-the-box (English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, German, Portuguese, French, Japanese, Korean).[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[b]
[size=5][b]🎮 Controls & Tips[/b][/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b][b]D-Pad / Left Stick:[/b] Snap between map buildings (Point-to-Point mode) or move freely (Free Cursor mode).[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Right Stick Click (R3) [Default]:[/b] Toggle Free Map Cursor mode ON / OFF with on-screen notification and audio feedback.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Controller A / X:[/b] Open the Ridgeside Village map when highlighting its button.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]DualShock / DualSense Touchpad Tip:[/b] To open/close the world map using the physical touchpad on PlayStation controllers, enable Steam Input for Stardew Valley and bind [b]Trackpad Click[/b] to keyboard key [b]M[/b]![/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[b]
[size=5][b]⚙️ Configuration[/b][/size]
Configure in-game via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], or edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]:[/b]
[code]
{
  "FreeCursorToggle": "R3",
  "OpenMapKey": "None"
}[/code][list]
[*][b][b]FreeCursorToggle:[/b] Button to switch cursor modes. Set to [font=Courier New]"R3"[/font] or [font=Courier New]"L3"[/font].[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]OpenMapKey:[/b] Optional keybind for opening/closing the map (set to [font=Courier New]"None"[/font] by default to avoid conflicting with vanilla controller buttons like Journal/Share).[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[b]
[size=5][b]📦 Compatibility[/b][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b].[/b][/*]
[*][b]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b], [b]Ridgeside Village[/b], [b]Sunberry Village[/b], [b]East Scarp[/b], and all map mods using the standard 1.6 World Map API.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Safe to install or remove at any time without affecting save files.[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[b]
[size=5][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url].
2. Download this mod and extract the [font=Courier New]WorldMapGamepadAutonav[/font] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] directory.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI and enjoy effortless map navigation on your gamepad![/b]

Downloads.Description: Perfectly works with SMAPI 4.5.2 (fixed little bugs)

Manifest.Name: World Map Gamepad Autonav
Manifest.Description: Automatically enables gamepad controller snapping and point-to-point navigation for all vanilla and modded locations on the world map, keeping each region map strictly isolated.
